title: Astro - The Future Portal
tagline: Build the future. Build the fortune.
description:
It is a multi-chain decentralized prediction market. (Supported on Cronos, Shardeum & Mumbai Polygon)
Enables secure on-chain transaction by making distributing liquidity across different smart contracts for different markets.
how_its_made:
Integrating Biconomy and upgradeable contracts together.
Dependency on subgraphs. And some chains didn't have subgraph support.
Factory Child contract's subgraph mapping.
Designing architecture of Question Bank
Packing-unpacking of data for some flows.
